cases.input: A substantive presentation needs a precise audience, decision ask, approved template, material figures and editable PPTX/PDF delivery into the tenant Drive.
requiredBehaviors: use proportional Grilling when material requirements are unresolved
freeze intent content visual and Drive delivery requirements before rendering
classify material requirements as INVARIANT CONTROLLED or ADAPTIVE
forbiddenBehaviors: allow a renderer to reinterpret the user brief or use a local download as canonical delivery

cases.input: A PDF is requested from an already approved frozen canonical DOCX with no new content or design requirement.
forbiddenBehaviors: create an independent PDF design brief

cases.input: A renderer wants to replace an approved figure, change an invariant footer and deliver from a sandbox because the Drive upload was skipped.
requiredBehaviors: keep final delivery pending until canonical Drive persistence succeeds
forbiddenBehaviors: treat sandbox output as final canonical delivery

cases.input: A substantive PPTX/PDF package has completed Grilling and production. The renderer wants to hand back local files immediately.
requiredBehaviors: require the frozen Artifact Production Contract to govern the exact candidate
persist the exact approved artifacts to recipient-owned canonical Google Drive
read back and register observed Drive identities
return observed Drive links as the successful final handoff
forbiddenBehaviors: treat local or sandbox files as final delivery
skip contract audit because rendering succeeded
fall back to GitHub as canonical artifact storage
